mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SY_AI_QNA (QNA_ID, USER_ID, QSTN_CN, ANS_CN, USE_DATA_DESC, BASE_YM, PRVS_YN, ANS_STAT_CD, QSTN_DTTM, REG_USER_ID, REG_DTTM) VALUES (CAST(#{id} AS NUMERIC), #{actor}, #{question}, #{answer}, #{description}, #{baseMonth}, #{provisional}, #{status}, clock_timestamp(), #{actor}, clock_timestamp())
mapper.select: SELECT q.QNA_ID::TEXT AS "questionId", q.QSTN_CN AS "question", q.QSTN_DTTM AS "askedAt", q.ANS_STAT_CD AS "answerStatus" FROM TB_SY_AI_QNA q WHERE q.USER_ID = #{actor} ORDER BY q.QSTN_DTTM DESC, q.QNA_ID DESC
SELECT q.ANS_CN FROM TB_SY_AI_QNA q WHERE q.USER_ID = #{actor} AND q.QNA_ID = CAST(#{id} AS NUMERIC)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SY_ACCS_LOG (LOG_ID, USER_ID, ACT_TYPE_CD, SCRN_ID, TRGT_DESC, ACT_DTTM, REG_USER_ID, REG_DTTM) VALUES (nextval('SQ_TB_SY_ACCS_LOG'), #{actor}, 'DNLD', 'UI-26', 'AI 분석 답 ' || #{id}, clock_timestamp(), #{actor}, clock_timestamp())
mapper.select: SELECT d.DEV_NM AS "name", d.MNG_NO AS "replacement" FROM TB_HR_DEV d UNION ALL SELECT u.USER_NM AS "name", ''::TEXT AS "replacement" FROM TB_SY_USER u WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_HR_DEV d WHERE d.DEV_NM = u.USER_NM)
